name: MACS J2229.7-2755 (Hubble)
blurb: MACS J2229.7-2755, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: macsj222972755-hubble
story: A massive cluster of galaxies, one of the X-ray brightest found by the Massive Cluster Survey, with a single giant galaxy sitting right at the peak of the cluster's X-ray glow. Hubble surveyed clusters like this one hunting for bright giant arcs to study more closely.

claims.text: MACS J2229.7-2755 is one of the X-ray brightest clusters of galaxies from the Massive Cluster Survey
It has a pronounced cool core with the X-ray peak well aligned with a single cD (giant central) galaxy
It is a target of Hubble program 12884, a snapshot survey of the most massive galaxy clusters, which aims to discover bright giant arcs
